newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Van der Horst sees improved second-half.
newsitem.headline: Van der Horst sees improved second-half.

text.p: Van der Horst Ltd said on Monday it expected its performance in the second half of the year to show some improvement over the first half.
It said in a statement that with the completion of the Indonesian elections, the group's three current projects are expected to make reasonable progress in the second half.
The group reported first-half profits for six months to March 31, 1997, plunged 84 percent to Singapore $4.1 million.
It attributed declines almost entirely to delays in three current projects in Indonesia -- Jakarta Depot Satellite and Surabaya Depot Satellite pipelines and a Semarang power plant.
Each of the projects consists of three separate contracts, namely design and engineering consultancy, construction and material supply, it said.
